name: Room 304 - A Boys' Love Story
source:
Room 304 is a short boys' love visual novel set in a quiet dormitory. You'll meet Ian, the timid boy with brown hair, and Eric, his more confident roommate. Over four days, everyday moments slowly reveal their fears, hopes, and hidden feelings. The room carries a rumor of a curse, blurring the line between comfort and unease.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4059320/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《304房间》是一部以安静的宿舍为背景的短篇男生爱情视觉小说。你会遇到伊恩，一个胆小的棕色头发男孩，和埃里克，他更自信的室友。在四天的时间里，日常生活中的时刻慢慢地揭示了他们的恐惧、希望和隐藏的感受。房间里流传着诅咒的谣言，模糊了舒适与不安之间的界限。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4059320/]Steam[/url]]
